name: smtp-panel
description: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV + Queues 的 SMTP 批量发信管理系统

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply smtp-panel --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply smtp-panel --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
